text: Kidai Plugin Market Hub 纪代插件市场是面向 DSH Web 客户端的插件市场。它在侧边栏提供启动入口，并以全屏页面连接目录与当前 profile。用户可以从 GitHub、npm 和社区精选目录搜索插件，查看已安装项目，安装、启用、禁用、更新或卸载插件，也能检查残留插件并重新挂载。页面还提供本地目录入口和重启操作。适合希望在 DSH 内集中发现与维护插件的用户；使用安装功能需要本机可用的 pnpm 和网络连接。

Kidai Plugin Market Hub is a DSH web marketplace. Open its sidebar catalog to search GitHub, npm, and curated listings, then install and manage plugins in the active profile. It also supports updates, orphan discovery, and restart controls. Installing requires pnpm and network access.

Kidai Plugin Market Hub 的功能「多源目录搜索」：市场页聚合 GitHub、npm 和社区精选来源，支持按名称或描述搜索并排序；客户端向目录查询方法请求结果。
Kidai Plugin Market Hub 的功能「安装与 profile 管理」：用户选择 npm 包名或 GitHub 仓库后可发起安装，并从已安装页启用、禁用、更新或卸载插件。
Kidai Plugin Market Hub 的功能「孤儿插件管理」：扫描 profile 中已存在但未挂载的插件，并提供重新挂载或移除残留文件的操作。
Kidai Plugin Market Hub 的功能「侧边栏全屏 Hub」：客户端注册侧边栏启动按钮和 shell 覆盖层，提供插件市场与已安装页面，并提供重启操作入口。

text:
kidai-plugin-market-hub README · ✨ 为什么用它：> **无需懂任何技术细节** — 普通用户打开即用;开发者也能享受完整的安装安全网。

---

kidai-plugin-market-hub README · 🚀 快速开始：在 DSH 命令行中执行(Desktop 用 `desktop`,Web 用 `web`):

```bash
dsh plugin --profile desktop add kidai-plugin-market-hub
```

然后**重启 DSH**,主页侧边栏「设置」按钮上方会出现「纪代市场」入口,点击进入全屏市场页。

卸载:

```bash
dsh plugin --profile desktop remove kidai-plugin-market-hub
```

> 需要本机可用的 `pnpm`(或 DSH 自带的 pnpm),并确保能访问 `api.github.com`(目录)与 `registry.npmjs.org`(安装校验)。

---

kidai-plugin-market-hub README · 立即重启：Hub 顶部常驻「立即重启」,两步确认后即时生效。

---

kidai-plugin-market-hub README · 🖥️ 支持的部署形态：| 部署形态 | 启动方式 | 状态 |
| --- | --- | --- |
| **Desktop 应用**(内嵌 Web 界面) | 启动 DSH Desktop | ✅ 完整可用 |
| **独立 Web 部署** | `dsh --profile web --port 8080` | ✅ 完整可用 |

两种形态功能完全一致,唯一差异:独立 Web 部署无 Electron,"立即重启"降级为手动重启提示。

---

kidai-plugin-market-hub README · ⚙️ 工作原理(技术细节)：| 组成部分 | 文件 | 说明 |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Host 半 | `lib/index.js` | Cordis 插件,`PluginMarketGateway`(`TypertRemoteService`,命名空间 `pluginMarketHub`),通过 SRC 标记暴露 `listPublished` / `installed` / `installPlugin` / `setEnabled` / `openLocal` / `cancelEnabled` / `checkUpdates` / `updatePlugin` / `fetchReadme` / `auditPackage` / `restartApp` / `uninstallPlugin` / `scanOrphanPlugins` / `mountOrphan` / `removeOrphanFiles`。 |
| 组合层 | `cordis.patch.yml` | 插入插件行;因包声明 `dsh.client`,同一行同时进入浏览器模块清单。 |
| Client 半 | `lib/client.js` | 浏览器 bundle:注册侧边栏启动器(`sidebar.footer.action`)与全屏 Hub 页(`shell.overlay`),挂载 Remote 描述符(手写严格 codec),渲染双页签 UI。 |
| 安装通道 | Host `installPlugin(spec)` | 校验 spec → 解析 pnpm → `pnpm add` → 收敛 `dsh.profile.bundles`。 |
| 重启通道 | Host `restartApp()` | 检测部署形态并请求重启;Hub 头部两步确认。 |

kidai-plugin-market-hub README · 📚 更多：- **更新记录**:[CHANGELOG.md](CHANGELOG.md)
- **开发与发布**:修改 `lib/index.js`(Host)重启生效;`lib/client.js`(浏览器)重启或走 `dsh-client-hmr` 热更。语法检查 `node --check lib/index.js && node --check lib/client.js`;测试套件见 `scripts/`。

text: kidai-plugin-market-hub README · ✨ Why use it：The DeepSeek Harness (DSH) plugin ecosystem keeps growing, but finding, installing and managing plugins is scattered across several places. **Kidai Plugin Market Hub** brings it all into one standalone full-screen page, one click away from the sidebar:

kidai-plugin-market-hub README · ✨ Why use it：> **No technical knowledge needed** — regular users can just open and use it; developers get a full installation safety net too.

---

kidai-plugin-market-hub README · 🚀 Quick start：From a DSH terminal (use `desktop` for the Desktop app, `web` for standalone web):

```bash
dsh plugin --profile desktop add kidai-plugin-market-hub
```

Then **restart DSH** — a "纪代市场" launcher appears above the 设置 (Settings) button in the home sidebar. Click it to open the full-screen marketplace.

Uninstall:

```bash
dsh plugin --profile desktop remove kidai-plugin-market-hub
```

kidai-plugin-market-hub README · 🚀 Quick start：> Requires a local `pnpm` (or DSH's bundled one) and network access to `api.github.com` (catalog) and `registry.npmjs.org` (install validation).

---

kidai-plugin-market-hub README · Restart：A permanent "Restart now" button on the hub header, two-step confirmed, applies immediately.

---

kidai-plugin-market-hub README · 🖥️ Supported deployments：| Deployment | How to start | Status |
| --- | --- | --- |
| **Desktop app** (embedded Web UI) | Launch DSH Desktop | ✅ Fully functional |
| **Standalone Web** | `dsh --profile web --port 8080` | ✅ Fully functional |

Both work identically; the only difference is a standalone Web deployment has no Electron runtime, so "Restart now" degrades to a manual-restart hint.

---

kidai-plugin-market-hub README · ⚙️ How it works (technical)：| Part | File | Notes |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Host half | `lib/index.js` | Cordis plugin, `PluginMarketGateway` (`TypertRemoteService`, namespace `pluginMarketHub`), exposing `listPublished` / `installed` / `installPlugin` / `setEnabled` / `openLocal` / `cancelEnabled` / `checkUpdates` / `updatePlugin` / `fetchReadme` / `auditPackage` / `restartApp` / `uninstallPlugin` / `scanOrphanPlugins` / `mountOrphan` / `removeOrphanFiles` via SRC markers. |
| Composition | `cordis.patch.yml` | Inserts the plugin rows; because the package declares `dsh.client`, the same rows feed the browser module manifest. |
| Client half | `lib/client.js` | Browser bundle: sidebar launcher (`sidebar.footer.action`) + full-screen hub page (`shell.overlay`), mounts the Remote descriptors (hand-written strict codecs), renders the two-tab UI. |
| Install channel | Host `installPlugin(spec)` | Validate spec → resolve pnpm → `pnpm add` → reconcile `dsh.profile.bundles`. |
| Restart channel | Host `restartApp()` | Detects the deployment and requests a restart; two-step confirm in the hub header. |

kidai-plugin-market-hub README · Catalog sources：When `github.com` is unreachable, whole-repo installs automatically switch to the **tarball chain** (codeload → ghproxy → ghfast → gh-proxy) instead of stalling on the git protocol. If everything fails, the offline cache is returned.

---

kidai-plugin-market-hub README · 📚 More：- **Changelog**: [CHANGELOG.md](CHANGELOG.md)
- **Develop & publish**: `lib/index.js` (Host) changes apply on restart; `lib/client.js` (browser) on restart or via `dsh-client-hmr`. Syntax check `node --check lib/index.js && node --check lib/client.js`; test suites live under `scripts/`.
